select h.id, 'HELP' as type, h.create_user as createUser, ui.nickname, h.title, h.description, IFNULL(h.comment_count, 0) as commentCount, IFNULL(h.like_count, 0) as likeCount, h.create_time as createTime from help h left join user_info ui on h.create_user = ui.user_id where 1=1
and (h.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or h.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
select ho.id, 'HOLE' as type, ho.create_user as createUser, ui.nickname, null as title, ho.content as description, ho.comment_count as commentCount, ho.like_count as likeCount, ho.create_time as createTime from hole ho left join user_info ui on ho.create_user = ui.user_id where 1=1
and ho.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select l.id, 'LOST' as type, l.create_user as createUser, ui.nickname, null as title, l.description, l.comment_count as commentCount, l.like_count as likeCount, l.create_time as createTime from lost l left join user_info ui on l.create_user = ui.user_id where 1=1
and l.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
select d.id, 'DYNAMIC' as type, d.create_user as createUser, ui.nickname, d.title, d.content as description, d.comment_count as commentCount, d.like_count as likeCount, d.create_time as createTime from dynamic d left join user_info ui on d.create_user = ui.user_id where 1=1
and (d.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by createTime desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
